product.name: TerraGauge Pro 200
product.description: The TerraGauge Pro 200 is a compact, handheld tire pressure gauge designed for quick and accurate readings on passenger and light truck tires. Its ergonomic handle and clear LCD display allow drivers to monitor pressure in real time, helping maintain optimal tire performance and safety. The gauge features a durable ABS housing and a rubberized grip that resists slipping even in wet conditions. A built‑in LED illuminates the display for use in low‑light environments, and a magnetic base keeps the unit secure on metal surfaces. The device is lightweight and portable, making it a convenient addition to any vehicle maintenance kit.
